# Media

Photo frame, gallery and lightbox.

[Shot](#shot) · [Gallery, Lightbox](#gallery-lightbox)

### Shot

The padded, rounded, lifted frame for screenshots and photos. Reserves its space so the layout does not jump while the image loads.

```ts
import { Shot } from '@/kit/components/media/Shot'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` *(required)* | `string` |  | Image URL. For files in `public/` use `asset("images/x.png")` so it works under a sub-path. |
| `alt` *(required)* | `string` |  | Alternative text. |
| `width` | `number` | `1600` | Intrinsic width; sets the aspect ratio. |
| `height` | `number` | `1000` | Intrinsic height; sets the aspect ratio. |
| `caption` | `ReactNode` |  | Text under the image. |
| `onOpen` | `() => void` |  | Makes the photo a button, e.g. to open a lightbox. |
| `priority` | `boolean` |  | Load immediately instead of lazily (above the fold). |

```tsx
<Shot src={asset('images/dashboard.png')} alt="The dashboard" caption="Sample data." />
```

### Gallery, Lightbox

A responsive photo grid that opens a full-screen viewer (Gallery), and the viewer itself (Lightbox).

```ts
import { Gallery, Lightbox } from '@/kit/components/media/Gallery'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` *(required)* | `{ src: string; alt: string; caption?: string; width?: number; height?: number }[]` |  | The photos. |
| `index` *(required)* | `number \| null` |  | Lightbox: index of the open photo, or null when closed. |
| `onIndexChange` *(required)* | `(index: number \| null) => void` |  | Lightbox: called when the viewer navigates or closes. |

```tsx
<Gallery items={[{ src: asset('images/one.jpg'), alt: 'Morning light', caption: 'Morning light' }]} />
```

- ← → browse, Esc closes, focus is trapped and page scroll is locked while open.
